content.text: {"headline":"Approve P4: overtime, cross-skilled moves and chat deflection. Predicted 86.2% service level over 15:15-19:45 for ₹4,092.","why":"The spike is demand, not staffing. The 12:30 credit card limit SMS (MKT-2026-951) drove new_offer_enquiry calls to 5.2x normal, and general queue service level has fallen to 0% with 28 abandons. Doing nothing leaves the window at 76.2%, below the 80% target, with general at 64.9%. P4 is the only policy-compliant plan that reaches target. It predicts 86.2% overall, with general at 79.2% and payments at 95.1%. Abandons fall to 2.6% from 5.0%, and the rest of the day is predicted at 86.4%.","trade_offs":["Cost: P4 costs ₹4,092. The no-cost options fall short: P0 reaches 76.2% and P1 reaches 75.4%.","P2 (₹420, 82.3%) and P3 (₹4,020, 88.5%) are cheaper or stronger. Both break policy CX-01, because they use a known-issue IVR message without a confirmed outage or incident.","Customer impact: general is still slightly under target at 79.2%. The overall figure clears 80% because payments is strong.","Risk to payments is low. Moving cross-skilled agents still leaves payments at 95.1%, versus 90.8% with no action."],"watch":"Check how many agents accept overtime, especially the 12 needed for 17:00-19:00. P4 depends on it. Track the general queue closely, since it is predicted just under 80%. Escalation is not required."}
